n: SikaRoof VersiFrame Edge Support Spacer Tab

d.t: SPACER TAB FOR EDGE SUPPORT ON HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM
d.s: SikaRoof VersiFrame Edge Support Spacer Tab is a spacer tab used on top of edge supports to create precise and uniform gaps for the alignment of pavers in raised flooring systems. Spacer tabs are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it rotates 360° to be able to support narrow or non-right angled pavers to be installed along perimeter wall, bridge over obstructions on the roof, and support odd-shaped pavers to achieve unique patterns and layouts of raised flooring. SikaRoof VersiFrame Edge Support Spacer Tab is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiFrame Edge Support and is placed in three possible rails to maximise variation in spacer tab placement to support as many unique paver designs as possible.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Spacer tabs are used with edge supports for raised flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
